name: rise-of-ages
description: An incremental game about carrying one nation from the Ancient world to the Information Age. Gather six resources, staff them with citizens, research four library tracks and advance the ages.

scripts.sheet: tsc --ignoreConfig sheet.ts --module commonjs --target ES2022 --lib ES2022,DOM --skipLibCheck --outDir tmp && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('tmp/package.json',JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}))" && node tmp/sheet.js icons.html
scripts.balance: tsc --ignoreConfig balance.ts --module commonjs --target ES2022 --lib ES2022,DOM --skipLibCheck --outDir tmp && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('tmp/package.json',JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}))" && node tmp/balance.js
